• model_gender: Model -> 'women'|'men'. Flat lay/hanger/mannequin -> null.

(2) Garment Criteria: flat lays determined by cut ('women' for floral/blouses/skirts/sandals; 'men' for masculine cuts; 'unisex' for neutral basics). (3) Neutral basics fall back to profile gender, or 'unisex'. Never default to 'men'.

• fabric_materials: [{"name": str, "pct": int}] summing to 100. tags: [str] (3-4 unique tags, never duplicate sub_category).
• pattern: 'solid'|'printed'|'geometric'|'striped'|'plaid'|'floral'|'camouflage'.
• text/logos: Read accurately ('American Eagle'=eagle/עיט, not deer/אייל).
• season: ['spring'|'summer'|'fall'|'winter']. Basics=['spring','summer','fall','winter'].
• Quality & Repair: Only emit 'reconstruction_prompt' if image_quality_status != 'complete'. Set null if complete.

Output raw JSON only ({...} or [{...}]). No markdown/intro.
• name & title: Short, unique (2-4 words) extracting cut/attributes (e.g. 'Green Round-Toe Loafers', 'Navy Chinos', 'Camo Cargo Pants'). Never generic ('Green Garment', 'Clothing').
• sub_category: Specific cut ('T-Shirt','Sweater','Jeans','Pants','Skirt','Shoes','Sneakers','Sandals','Boots','Loafers','Sunglasses','Handbag'). Never 'Top'/'Bottom'/'Footwear'.

• Footwear: 'Shoes' (oxfords/derbies), 'Sneakers', 'Sandals', 'Loafers', 'Boots' (ankle/combat). Laced/ankle are 'Boots'; low dress shoes are 'Shoes'.
• Accessories: 'Sunglasses','Handbag','Crossbody Bag','Belts','Headwear','Scarves & Wraps'. Non-wearables -> is_clothing:false.
• item_type: Detailed cut ('Crew-Neck T-Shirt','Chinos','Straight Jeans','Double Monk Strap Shoes'). Differ from sub_category.
• caption: <=12 words fluent sentence in requested language. End with period. No brackets/lists.
• dress_code: 'casual'|'smart-casual'|'business'|'formal'|'athletic'|'loungewear'. Suits='business'; shirts='smart-casual'; tuxedos='formal'.
• model_gender: Model -> 'women'|'men'. Flat lay/hanger/mannequin -> null.
• gender: Strict 3-Tier Hierarchy: (1) Human Model: anchor to model gender ('women'|'men'). (2) Garment Criteria: flat lays determined by cut ('women' for floral/blouses/skirts/sandals; 'men' for masculine cuts; 'unisex' for neutral basics). (3) Neutral basics fall back to profile gender, or 'unisex'. Never default to 'men'.
• colors: ALWAYS [{"name": str, "pct": int}] summing to 100. Indoor white/cream tops must be 'white'/'cream', never 'grey'.
• fabric_materials: [{"name": str, "pct": int}] summing to 100. tags: [str] (3-4 unique tags, never duplicate sub_category).
• pattern: 'solid'|'printed'|'geometric'|'striped'|'plaid'|'floral'|'camouflage'.
• text/logos: Read accurately ('American Eagle'=eagle/עיט, not deer/אייל).
• season: ['spring'|'summer'|'fall'|'winter']. Basics=['spring','summer','fall','winter'].
• Quality & Repair: Only emit 'reconstruction_prompt' if image_quality_status != 'complete'. Set null if complete.

Output raw JSON only ({...} or [{...}]). No markdown/intro.
• name & title: Short, unique (2-4 words) extracting cut/attributes (e.g. 'Green Round-Toe Loafers', 'Navy Chinos', 'Camo Cargo Pants'). Never generic ('Green Garment', 'Clothing').
• sub_category: Specific cut ('T-Shirt','Sweater','Jeans','Pants','Skirt','Shoes','Sneakers','Sandals','Boots','Loafers','Sunglasses','Handbag'). Never 'Top'/'Bottom'/'Footwear'.
• Bottoms: 'Jeans'=denim. Chinos -> sub_category:'Pants', item_type:'Chinos', dress_code:'smart-casual'. Sweatpants/joggers -> sub_category:'Pants', item_type:'Sweatpants'|'Joggers', dress_code:'casual'|'athletic'.
• Footwear: 'Shoes' (oxfords/derbies), 'Sneakers', 'Sandals', 'Loafers', 'Boots' (ankle/combat). Laced/ankle are 'Boots'; low dress shoes are 'Shoes'.

• item_type: Detailed cut ('Crew-Neck T-Shirt','Chinos','Straight Jeans','Double Monk Strap Shoes'). Differ from sub_category.
• caption: <=12 words fluent sentence in requested language. End with period. No brackets/lists.
• dress_code: 'casual'|'smart-casual'|'business'|'formal'|'athletic'|'loungewear'. Suits='business'; shirts='smart-casual'; tuxedos='formal'.
• model_gender: Model -> 'women'|'men'. Flat lay/hanger/mannequin -> null.
• gender: Strict 3-Tier Hierarchy: (1) Human Model: anchor to model gender ('women'|'men'). (2) Garment Criteria: flat lays determined by cut ('women' for floral/blouses/skirts/sandals; 'men' for masculine cuts; 'unisex' for neutral basics). (3) Neutral basics fall back to profile gender, or 'unisex'. Never default to 'men'.
• colors: ALWAYS [{"name": str, "pct": int}] summing to 100. Indoor white/cream tops must be 'white'/'cream', never 'grey'.
• fabric_materials: [{"name": str, "pct": int}] summing to 100. tags: [str] (3-4 unique tags, never duplicate sub_category).
• pattern: 'solid'|'printed'|'geometric'|'striped'|'plaid'|'floral'|'camouflage'.
• text/logos: Read accurately ('American Eagle'=eagle/עיט, not deer/אייל).
• season: ['spring'|'summer'|'fall'|'winter']. Basics=['spring','summer','fall','winter'].
• Quality & Repair: Only emit 'reconstruction_prompt' if image_quality_status != 'complete'. Set null if complete.

• Footwear: 'Shoes' (oxfords/derbies), 'Sneakers', 'Sandals', 'Loafers', 'Boots' (ankle/combat). Laced/ankle are 'Boots'; low dress shoes are 'Shoes'.

Output raw JSON only ({...} or [{...}]). No markdown/intro.
• name & title: Short, unique (2-4 words) extracting cut/attributes (e.g. 'Green Round-Toe Loafers', 'Navy Chinos', 'Camo Cargo Pants'). Never generic ('Green Garment', 'Clothing').
• sub_category: Specific cut ('T-Shirt','Sweater','Jeans','Pants','Skirt','Shoes','Sneakers','Sandals','Boots','Loafers','Sunglasses','Handbag'). Never 'Top'/'Bottom'/'Footwear'.
• Bottoms: 'Jeans'=denim. Chinos -> sub_category:'Pants', item_type:'Chinos', dress_code:'smart-casual'. Sweatpants/joggers -> sub_category:'Pants', item_type:'Sweatpants'|'Joggers', dress_code:'casual'|'athletic'.
• Footwear: 'Shoes' (oxfords/derbies), 'Sneakers', 'Sandals', 'Loafers', 'Boots' (ankle/combat). Laced/ankle are 'Boots'; low dress shoes are 'Shoes'.
• Accessories: 'Sunglasses','Handbag','Crossbody Bag','Belts','Headwear','Scarves & Wraps'. Non-wearables -> is_clothing:false.
• item_type: Detailed cut ('Crew-Neck T-Shirt','Chinos','Straight Jeans','Double Monk Strap Shoes'). Differ from sub_category.
• caption: <=12 words fluent sentence in requested language. End with period. No brackets/lists.
• dress_code: 'casual'|'smart-casual'|'business'|'formal'|'athletic'|'loungewear'. Suits='business'; shirts='smart-casual'; tuxedos='formal'.
• model_gender: Model -> 'women'|'men'. Flat lay/hanger/mannequin -> null.
• gender: Strict 3-Tier Hierarchy: (1) Human Model: anchor to model gender ('women'|'men'). (2) Garment Criteria: flat lays determined by cut ('women' for floral/blouses/skirts/sandals; 'men' for masculine cuts; 'unisex' for neutral basics). (3) Neutral basics fall back to profile gender, or 'unisex'. Never default to 'men'.
• colors: ALWAYS [{"name": str, "pct": int}] summing to 100. Indoor white/cream tops must be 'white'/'cream', never 'grey'.
• fabric_materials: [{"name": str, "pct": int}] summing to 100. tags: [str] (3-4 unique tags, never duplicate sub_category).
• pattern: 'solid'|'printed'|'geometric'|'striped'|'plaid'|'floral'|'camouflage'.
• text/logos: Read accurately ('American Eagle'=eagle/עיט, not deer/אייל).
• season: ['spring'|'summer'|'fall'|'winter']. Basics=['spring','summer','fall','winter'].
• Quality & Repair: Only emit 'reconstruction_prompt' if image_quality_status != 'complete'. Set null if complete.

Output raw JSON only ({...} or [{...}]). No markdown/intro.

• sub_category: Specific cut ('T-Shirt','Sweater','Jeans','Pants','Skirt','Shoes','Sneakers','Sandals','Boots','Loafers','Sunglasses','Handbag'). Never 'Top'/'Bottom'/'Footwear'.
• Bottoms: 'Jeans'=denim. Chinos -> sub_category:'Pants', item_type:'Chinos', dress_code:'smart-casual'. Sweatpants/joggers -> sub_category:'Pants', item_type:'Sweatpants'|'Joggers', dress_code:'casual'|'athletic'.
• Footwear: 'Shoes' (oxfords/derbies), 'Sneakers', 'Sandals', 'Loafers', 'Boots' (ankle/combat). Laced/ankle are 'Boots'; low dress shoes are 'Shoes'.
• Accessories: 'Sunglasses','Handbag','Crossbody Bag','Belts','Headwear','Scarves & Wraps'. Non-wearables -> is_clothing:false.
• item_type: Detailed cut ('Crew-Neck T-Shirt','Chinos','Straight Jeans','Double Monk Strap Shoes'). Differ from sub_category.
• caption: <=12 words fluent sentence in requested language. End with period. No brackets/lists.
• dress_code: 'casual'|'smart-casual'|'business'|'formal'|'athletic'|'loungewear'. Suits='business'; shirts='smart-casual'; tuxedos='formal'.
• model_gender: Model -> 'women'|'men'. Flat lay/hanger/mannequin -> null.
• gender: Strict 3-Tier Hierarchy: (1) Human Model: anchor to model gender ('women'|'men'). (2) Garment Criteria: flat lays determined by cut ('women' for floral/blouses/skirts/sandals; 'men' for masculine cuts; 'unisex' for neutral basics). (3) Neutral basics fall back to profile gender, or 'unisex'. Never default to 'men'.
• colors: ALWAYS [{"name": str, "pct": int}] summing to 100. Indoor white/cream tops must be 'white'/'cream', never 'grey'.
• fabric_materials: [{"name": str, "pct": int}] summing to 100. tags: [str] (3-4 unique tags, never duplicate sub_category).
• pattern: 'solid'|'printed'|'geometric'|'striped'|'plaid'|'floral'|'camouflage'.
• text/logos: Read accurately ('American Eagle'=eagle/עיט, not deer/אייל).
• season: ['spring'|'summer'|'fall'|'winter']. Basics=['spring','summer','fall','winter'].
• Quality & Repair: Only emit 'reconstruction_prompt' if image_quality_status != 'complete'. Set null if complete.

• model_gender: Model -> 'women'|'men'. Flat lay/hanger/mannequin -> null.

• pattern: 'solid'|'printed'|'geometric'|'striped'|'plaid'|'floral'|'camouflage'.
• text/logos: Read accurately ('American Eagle'=eagle/עיט, not deer/אייל).
• season: ['spring'|'summer'|'fall'|'winter']. Basics=['spring','summer','fall','winter'].
• Quality & Repair: Only emit 'reconstruction_prompt' if image_quality_status != 'complete'. Set null if complete.

• sub_category: Specific cut ('T-Shirt','Sweater','Jeans','Pants','Skirt','Shoes','Sneakers','Sandals','Boots','Loafers','Sunglasses','Handbag'). Never 'Top'/'Bottom'/'Footwear'.
• Bottoms: 'Jeans'=denim. Chinos -> sub_category:'Pants', item_type:'Chinos', dress_code:'smart-casual'. Sweatpants/joggers -> sub_category:'Pants', item_type:'Sweatpants'|'Joggers', dress_code:'casual'|'athletic'.
• Footwear: 'Shoes' (oxfords/derbies), 'Sneakers', 'Sandals', 'Loafers', 'Boots' (ankle/combat). Laced/ankle are 'Boots'; low dress shoes are 'Shoes'.
• Accessories: 'Sunglasses','Handbag','Crossbody Bag','Belts','Headwear','Scarves & Wraps'. Non-wearables -> is_clothing:false.
• item_type: Detailed cut ('Crew-Neck T-Shirt','Chinos','Straight Jeans','Double Monk Strap Shoes'). Differ from sub_category.

• fabric_materials: [{"name": str, "pct": int}] summing to 100. tags: [str] (3-4 unique tags, never duplicate sub_category).
• pattern: 'solid'|'printed'|'geometric'|'striped'|'plaid'|'floral'|'camouflage'.

• sub_category: Specific cut ('T-Shirt','Sweater','Jeans','Pants','Skirt','Shoes','Sneakers','Sandals','Boots','Loafers','Sunglasses','Handbag'). Never 'Top'/'Bottom'/'Footwear'.
• Bottoms: 'Jeans'=denim. Chinos -> sub_category:'Pants', item_type:'Chinos', dress_code:'smart-casual'. Sweatpants/joggers -> sub_category:'Pants', item_type:'Sweatpants'|'Joggers', dress_code:'casual'|'athletic'.
• Footwear: 'Shoes' (oxfords/derbies), 'Sneakers', 'Sandals', 'Loafers', 'Boots' (ankle/combat). Laced/ankle are 'Boots'; low dress shoes are 'Shoes'.

• model_gender: Model -> 'women'|'men'. Flat lay/hanger/mannequin -> null.

(2) Garment Criteria: flat lays determined by cut ('women' for floral/blouses/skirts/sandals; 'men' for masculine cuts; 'unisex' for neutral basics). • pattern: 'solid'|'printed'|'geometric'|'striped'|'plaid'|'floral'|'camouflage'.
• text/logos: Read accurately ('American Eagle'=eagle/עיט, not deer/אייל).
• season: ['spring'|'summer'|'fall'|'winter']. Basics=['spring','summer','fall','winter'].
• Quality & Repair: Only emit 'reconstruction_prompt' if image_quality_status != 'complete'. Set null if complete.

system_prompt:
Output raw JSON only ({...} or [{...}]). No markdown/intro.
• name & title: Short, unique (2-4 words) extracting cut/attributes (e.g. 'Green Round-Toe Loafers', 'Navy Chinos', 'Camo Cargo Pants'). Never generic ('Green Garment', 'Clothing').
• sub_category: Specific cut ('T-Shirt','Sweater','Jeans','Pants','Skirt','Shoes','Sneakers','Sandals','Boots','Loafers','Sunglasses','Handbag'). Never 'Top'/'Bottom'/'Footwear'.
• Bottoms: 'Jeans'=denim. Chinos -> sub_category:'Pants', item_type:'Chinos', dress_code:'smart-casual'. Sweatpants/joggers -> sub_category:'Pants', item_type:'Sweatpants'|'Joggers', dress_code:'casual'|'athletic'.
• Footwear: 'Shoes' (oxfords/derbies), 'Sneakers', 'Sandals', 'Loafers', 'Boots' (ankle/combat). Laced/ankle are 'Boots'; low dress shoes are 'Shoes'.
• Accessories: 'Sunglasses','Handbag','Crossbody Bag','Belts','Headwear','Scarves & Wraps'. Non-wearables -> is_clothing:false.
• item_type: Detailed cut ('Crew-Neck T-Shirt','Chinos','Straight Jeans','Double Monk Strap Shoes'). Differ from sub_category.
• caption: <=12 words fluent sentence in requested language. End with period. No brackets/lists.
• dress_code: 'casual'|'smart-casual'|'business'|'formal'|'athletic'|'loungewear'. Suits='business'; shirts='smart-casual'; tuxedos='formal'.
• model_gender: Model -> 'women'|'men'. Flat lay/hanger/mannequin -> null.
• gender: Strict 3-Tier Hierarchy: (1) Human Model: anchor to model gender ('women'|'men'). (2) Garment Criteria: flat lays determined by cut ('women' for floral/blouses/skirts/sandals; 'men' for masculine cuts; 'unisex' for neutral basics). (3) Neutral basics fall back to profile gender, or 'unisex'. Never default to 'men'.
• colors: ALWAYS [{"name": str, "pct": int}] summing to 100. Indoor white/cream tops must be 'white'/'cream', never 'grey'.
• fabric_materials: [{"name": str, "pct": int}] summing to 100. tags: [str] (3-4 unique tags, never duplicate sub_category).
• pattern: 'solid'|'printed'|'geometric'|'striped'|'plaid'|'floral'|'camouflage'.
• text/logos: Read accurately ('American Eagle'=eagle/עיט, not deer/אייל).
• season: ['spring'|'summer'|'fall'|'winter']. Basics=['spring','summer','fall','winter'].
• Quality & Repair: Only emit 'reconstruction_prompt' if image_quality_status != 'complete'. Set null if complete.

(2) Garment Criteria: flat lays determined by cut ('women' for floral/blouses/skirts/sandals; 'men' for masculine cuts; 'unisex' for neutral basics). • fabric_materials: [{"name": str, "pct": int}] summing to 100. tags: [str] (3-4 unique tags, never duplicate sub_category).
• pattern: 'solid'|'printed'|'geometric'|'striped'|'plaid'|'floral'|'camouflage'.
• text/logos: Read accurately ('American Eagle'=eagle/עיט, not deer/אייל).
• season: ['spring'|'summer'|'fall'|'winter']. Basics=['spring','summer','fall','winter'].
• Quality & Repair: Only emit 'reconstruction_prompt' if image_quality_status != 'complete'. Set null if complete.

• sub_category: Specific cut ('T-Shirt','Sweater','Jeans','Pants','Skirt','Shoes','Sneakers','Sandals','Boots','Loafers','Sunglasses','Handbag'). Never 'Top'/'Bottom'/'Footwear'.

• Footwear: 'Shoes' (oxfords/derbies), 'Sneakers', 'Sandals', 'Loafers', 'Boots' (ankle/combat). Laced/ankle are 'Boots'; low dress shoes are 'Shoes'.

• sub_category: Specific cut ('T-Shirt','Sweater','Jeans','Pants','Skirt','Shoes','Sneakers','Sandals','Boots','Loafers','Sunglasses','Handbag'). Never 'Top'/'Bottom'/'Footwear'.
• Bottoms: 'Jeans'=denim. Chinos -> sub_category:'Pants', item_type:'Chinos', dress_code:'smart-casual'. Sweatpants/joggers -> sub_category:'Pants', item_type:'Sweatpants'|'Joggers', dress_code:'casual'|'athletic'.
• Footwear: 'Shoes' (oxfords/derbies), 'Sneakers', 'Sandals', 'Loafers', 'Boots' (ankle/combat). Laced/ankle are 'Boots'; low dress shoes are 'Shoes'.
• Accessories: 'Sunglasses','Handbag','Crossbody Bag','Belts','Headwear','Scarves & Wraps'. Non-wearables -> is_clothing:false.
• item_type: Detailed cut ('Crew-Neck T-Shirt','Chinos','Straight Jeans','Double Monk Strap Shoes'). Differ from sub_category.
• caption: <=12 words fluent sentence in requested language. End with period. No brackets/lists.
• dress_code: 'casual'|'smart-casual'|'business'|'formal'|'athletic'|'loungewear'. Suits='business'; shirts='smart-casual'; tuxedos='formal'.
• model_gender: Model -> 'women'|'men'. Flat lay/hanger/mannequin -> null.
• gender: Strict 3-Tier Hierarchy: (1) Human Model: anchor to model gender ('women'|'men'). (2) Garment Criteria: flat lays determined by cut ('women' for floral/blouses/skirts/sandals; 'men' for masculine cuts; 'unisex' for neutral basics). (3) Neutral basics fall back to profile gender, or 'unisex'. Never default to 'men'.

• fabric_materials: [{"name": str, "pct": int}] summing to 100. tags: [str] (3-4 unique tags, never duplicate sub_category).
• pattern: 'solid'|'printed'|'geometric'|'striped'|'plaid'|'floral'|'camouflage'.
• text/logos: Read accurately ('American Eagle'=eagle/עיט, not deer/אייל).

• model_gender: Model -> 'women'|'men'. Flat lay/hanger/mannequin -> null.

(2) Garment Criteria: flat lays determined by cut ('women' for floral/blouses/skirts/sandals; 'men' for masculine cuts; 'unisex' for neutral basics). • pattern: 'solid'|'printed'|'geometric'|'striped'|'plaid'|'floral'|'camouflage'.
• text/logos: Read accurately ('American Eagle'=eagle/עיט, not deer/אייל).
• season: ['spring'|'summer'|'fall'|'winter']. Basics=['spring','summer','fall','winter'].
